text: Skip to main content Where to file addresses for taxpayers and tax professionals filing Form 1040-V More In File Individuals Who should file Steps to file your taxes File your tax return Free File Get an extension Amend return Your information Life events Students Employees Parents Military Seniors and retirees Businesses and self-employed Charities and nonprofits International taxpayers Governmental liaisons Federal, state and local governments Indian tribal governments Tax exempt bonds Taxpayer identification numbers (TIN) These Where to File addresses are to be used only by taxpayers and tax professionals filing Form 1040-V during calendar year 2025. Box 931000 Louisville, KY 40293-1000 Alabama, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas Internal Revenue Service P.O. Box 1214 Charlotte, NC 28201-1214 Send Form 1040-V to the address indicated below: If you are a taxpayer living in... then use this address... A foreign country, U.S. possession or territory*, or use an APO or FPO address, or file Form 2555 or 4563, or are a dual-status alien. *If you live in American Samoa, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands, or the Northern Mariana Islands, see Pub. 570. Internal Revenue Service P.O. Box 1303 Charlotte, NC 28201-1303 USA Note: Permanent residents of Guam or the Virgin Islands should not use Form 1040-V.
